01 · Project Overview

Bringing financial information into one reporting environment

At VS Information Systems, I independently built a Power BI reporting solution for Smile Media. The objective was to make revenue, profitability, expenses, receivables, payables and project performance easier for finance stakeholders to review.

I handled data cleaning, Power Query transformations, data modelling, DAX calculations and dashboard layout. The solution included seven core reporting modules plus customer, invoice, payment and project detail views.

The featured financial figures and dashboard screenshots come from different reporting periods. They should not be combined to calculate a single-period ratio.
02 · Financial Overview

Revenue, profitability and collection performance

January 2026 · Revenue snapshot

LKR 6.91M in year-to-date revenue was analysed. The leading project accounted for LKR 5.07M of reported revenue.

YTD revenueLKR 6.91M
Leading project revenueLKR 5.07M

The leading project figure is part of reported revenue, not additional revenue.

October 2025 · Receivables snapshot

LKR 2.39M in outstanding receivables and a 71.70-day average collection period were reported, covering 11 invoices across 6 debtors.

The reporting solution also included gross profit, expense and net profit modules. Specific consolidated amounts are not reproduced here without verified matching-period figures.

04 · Financial Analysis

From financial KPIs to detailed reporting

Beyond headline revenue, the reporting environment allowed users to review gross profit, expenses, net profit, customer balances and project-level financial performance. Reporting-period comparisons, invoice details and drill-through views supported more focused investigation.

Screenshots are taken from the supplied Smile Media dashboard PDF. Click any image to enlarge. Selected dashboard screenshots show different dates and should not be read as a single reporting period. Some original January 2026 screens were empty and have intentionally been omitted.

06 · Key Insights

What this reporting makes possible

Receivables visibility

Outstanding balances and collection-period measures help finance teams identify where invoice-level follow-up may be needed. The October 2025 snapshot provides a concrete example of debtor exposure.

Project and profit visibility

Combining revenue, expenses, gross profit and project details enables users to explore financial performance beyond top-line sales and investigate differences between estimated and actual project results.

These are analytical observations about the reporting solution, not claims that I generated client revenue or improved collections. Publish client-specific screenshots and figures only with appropriate permission.
